core_obligations: Reduce to a surjective etale affine U -> X with degree bound n; induct on n.
The stratum X_n (complement of Z_{n-1}) has U_n -> X_n finite locally free of degree n; hence X_n is a scheme by the finite-flat-equivalence proposition.
The interior X' of |Z_{n-1}| in |X| has U' -> X' surjective etale with fibre degrees bounded by n-1; the induction hypothesis gives a dense open scheme locus X'' inside X'.
X'' union X_n is open and dense in X by elementary topology.
proof_roadmap: Induction setup; stratum piece is a scheme; interior piece by induction; union open dense.
difficulty_reason: An induction-on-degree proof combining a stratified scheme piece with an interior recursive piece.
